facts.fact: 三记「为相机/为下药/为跟踪」后 Clay 让位，Brawley 接手终结殴打
facts.anchor: Clay lets me—he knows this one is mine

facts.fact: Clay 反问 Aaron：操纵监控系统的不只他一个
facts.anchor: You really think you’re the only one who can manipulate the security systems?

facts.fact: Clay 点破假名即完美隐身：没人会找「Luca」
facts.anchor: You came here under a false name, so as far as anyone here knows, Luca simply moved on

facts.fact: Brawley 与 Clay 把 Aaron 关进他埋 Kayla 的那口棺材
facts.anchor: This is the fate he chose for Kayla, and karma works in mysterious ways

facts.fact: 两人守共同秘密：Aaron 被埋回原处，Kayla 永不会知道
facts.anchor: I know he won’t tell Kayla that Aaron is buried here, and neither will I

facts.fact: Brawley 对 Vero 的怒点核心：切断芯片、独自冒险三天
facts.anchor: You went and did something reckless without me. Why?

facts.fact: 惩罚之后 Brawley 的告白：独一无二、属于我、我追随
facts.anchor: You’re one of a kind and you’re mine

facts.fact: Vero 自陈三天：曾想杀 Cave，确认非其过错后由他切芯片
facts.anchor: I planned to kill Cave until I realized it wasn’t his fault
